verdict.rationale: OCI's first-party docs have a dedicated SDK page stating that each official SDK includes code samples and documentation to create, test and troubleshoot apps that integrate with OCI services. The release notes add a Java SDK for Select AI, and OCI commits to 12 months' notice before breaking API changes. Missing for 10: an explicit list of supported SDK languages, depth of per-SDK documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration of the SDKs, and a published OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404).
